title: Tapping the power of midwives to reduce maternal mortality in Guatemala
lineage: Brief research notes paraphrase inspected passages; not a source copy.

passages.note: UNFPA profiles Rosa María Chex, a Guatemalan community midwife, who reported more than 23 years of practice and more than 1,000 births attended. These are reported cumulative experience, not a measured causal effect or national coverage.
